Bug_Title: IL: A collection is added to itself (IL_CONTAINER_ADDED_TO_ITSELF)
Bug_Details:
A collection is added to itself. As a result, computing the hashCode of this
set will throw a StackOverflowException.
Bug_Explanation: A HashSet is added to itself, causing a recursive reference. When attempting to compute the hashCode, it results in a StackOverflowError due to infinite recursion.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the method showBug() from the CollectionSelfAddition class, which adds a HashSet to itself. This operation triggers the bug by causing a StackOverflowError when attempting to compute the hashCode of the collection, resulting in the test case failing.
